title: Divine Discrimination and the Living Spirit's Operations
summary: The Lord's discriminating presence and his constructive operations through the Living Spirit. T28 expounds the Twelve Judges sent forth from Greatness — the Lord's discrimination at twelve registers. T29 maps the throne-stations where the Lord is recognized as he goes forth. T30 describes the three garments (wind/water/fire as thought/truth/love) by which the Lord's operative power orders the natural. T31 unfolds how the Lord's call descends into every member of the soul. T32 enumerates seven works by which the Living Spirit builds spiritual structure. T33 describes five supports the Lord has set within the very body of the proprium. T34 lists further ordering works carried out within the captive archons. T35 treats the four works of the Ambassador. T36 sets the wheel of judgment before the King of Glory. T37 describes the three nested zones by which the proprium is fettered inside the rational.
organizing_principle: The Lord's discriminating presence at twelve registers (T28-T29) precedes his many constructive operations (T30-T37), which are elaborations of how he reorders the natural through the Living Spirit, the Ambassador, the Wheel, and the Zones. The arc is from judgment to construction — what the Lord sees, he then orders. The numbered enumerations (twelve judges, twelve thrones, three garments, seven works, five supports, four works of Ambassador, three zones) all describe one operative power working in different registers.
